_meta.surface: Dashboard tab inside the admin SPA. The tab is the default landing tab after admin login. The dashboard renders two stat cards: 'Tổng doanh thu (Delivered)' and 'Tổng số đơn hàng'.
_meta.note: The DB is seeded at startup with 18 orders (2 delivered: 600000 and 100000). The dashboard's revenue formula is `sum(o.total_amount * 2 for delivered)` — the `* 2` is a known SUT defect. Tests use BEFORE/AFTER deltas so they are robust against the seed count evolving. Each test seeds through the real admin endpoint chain (register a fresh user → checkout → admin flips status). No `waitForTimeout`; all waits are state-based.

cases.description: unauthenticated visit to the admin app renders the 'Admin Login' form instead of the dashboard
successful login with the seeded admin credentials renders the dashboard tab by default
the dashboard header 'Dashboard' is rendered after login
the 'Tổng doanh thu (Delivered)' stat card is rendered
the 'Tổng số đơn hàng' stat card is rendered
adding N pending orders increases the dashboard's total order count by exactly N
adding N pending orders does NOT change the delivered revenue
adding ONE delivered order increases the displayed revenue by amount * 2 (proves the SUT's '× 2' defect)
BVA: adding a 1 VND delivered order increases the revenue by 2
BVA: adding a 30,000,000 VND delivered order increases the revenue by 60,000,000
login as a non-admin account shows the 'role check' alert and does NOT render the dashboard
login with the wrong password shows the 'Đăng nhập thất bại' alert and the form remains
before login, the sidebar nav items (Dashboard, Danh mục, Sản phẩm, ...) are NOT rendered
after login, the sidebar nav items are rendered (at least the 'Dashboard' tab is visible)
clicking the 'Đơn hàng' sidebar tab switches away from the dashboard
the revenue stat card formats the number with Vietnamese grouping and a '₫' suffix
BUG-FR-13-001 detector: the dashboard's revenue cell equals the CORRECT sum of delivered amounts (not × 2). Fails on the buggy SUT where revenue shows twice the actual value.
BUG-FR-13-001 ratio detector: dashboard revenue is exactly 2× the correct sum. Confirms the bug from the GitHub issue is still present and reproducible.
